description: PLA category-level response rate for a marketplace over a period: ad requests, non-zero responses, and response rate (%), grouped by page type and category hierarchy (category_l1 / category_l2 / category_l3). Defaults to non-search pages; page_type and category levels are filterable. No spend / no currency conversion.

page_type.description: The surface the ad served on (CATEGORY, PRODUCT, HOME, SEARCH, ...). Defaults to non-search pages; filter to a specific page type as needed.

category_l1.description: Top-level (L1) product category the requests/responses were attributed to.

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: Ad requests received for this page type + category.

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END), 0)
responses.description: Requests that returned at least one ad (non-zero responses) for this page type + category.

response_rate.selector: SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END) * 100, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0))
response_rate.description: Response rate (%) = non-zero responses / requests * 100 for this page type + category.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_product_ads_filtered_level_report` AS r JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON r.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND r.category_l1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(r.category_l1) != '' AND r.page_type IS NOT NULL AND r.page_type NOT IN ('', 'NA') AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
